role: Graph traversal and query constants for the Co-Being knowledge graph layer.
detail: Defines a single operational limit constant (MAX_TRAVERSAL_DEPTH=5) that constrains graph traversal depth to protect query performance at scale (100,000+ nodes). This constant is referenced by read query functions and graph-traversing components across the Co-Being layer. The limit is non-overridable by callers without explicit CANON amendment, enforced by the query interface. Unbounded traversal is O(V+E) and unacceptable for real-time operation (D-TS-11).
gotchas: Non-overridable constraint tied to CANON immutability; any relaxation of the depth limit requires formal amendment.
